tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral gyi dbang dang las bdag pho mo'i bka'

gtad dang bcas pa byin rlabs gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las sgo brgya pa// drag po'i las kyis gcig char du// sgrub mdzad 'chi bdag dgra de la// gus btud beng chen dbang bskur sbyin// dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa bsnyen pa drod tshad thob pa'i sngags pas 'di'i dbang bskur snod ldan la sbyin par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du 'bru nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i bum pa mgul chings sngon po can nang du bum rdzas so lnga dang chu chang gis sum gnyis bkang ba'i kha rgyan gyi khrod du mgon po gtso 'khor lnga'i tsaka li dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod/ dpal gtor 'khor gru gsum bzhis bskor ba dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa gdugs dang bcas pa/ sman rak+ta/ tsan+dan gyi beng*/ lcags par/ ral gri rnams kyang bshams/ mchod pa ci 'byor pas bskor la/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas bzung ste shā sa na'i bzlas pa'i bar du 'di nyid kyi phrin las kyi rim pa dngos grub kun 'byung ltar bsgrubs rjes/ spro na tshogs mchod nas lhag gtor yan chad bya'o// de nas slob ma zung du ma gyur pa bcu phrag las mi mang bar khrus bya/ gral la 'khod cing bgegs la gtor ma btang zhing bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ slob mas kha na ma tho ba med pa'i 'jug yon maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kye ma bla ma rdo rje 'dzin// khro chen 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba| |bdag la brtse bas rab dgongs shing*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// lha chen drag po 'khor bcas rnams// dbang dang byin rlabs stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma'i mgor rdo rje bzhag /lce la a mṛ ta sbyin zhing*/

hoḥ 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste// gsang sngags kun gyi srog yin phyir// 'da' bar dka' ba'i lam yin no// gal te rtsa ba yan lag gi// dam las 'das na ye shes kyi// rdo rje me 'od rab 'bar bas// khyod kyi mgo snying 'gas par byed// 'chi med bcud ldan dam tshig chu// dam bsrung dngos grub kun stsol la// 'dis ni nyams na dmyal bar ltung*// de bas dam las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ ma hā kā lā badz+ra sa ma ya pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me lta bu ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su zhes pa nas myur mgyogs glog 'khyug pa ltar spyan drangs zhes pa'i bar phrin las gzhung ltar la/ slob ma'i lus la rgya mtsho chen por char bab pa ltar sib sib thim pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ sha chen gyi gu gul dang sbyar ba'i spos bsregs/ dur khrod kyi rol mo'i sgra skad drag po bsgrags shing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings 'dus ma byas// zhes pa nas bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol gyi bar phrin las ltar spyan drangs/ rgyas par na sngags thams cad kyi mjug tu/ ā we sha ya a a aḥ btags pa dang*/ bsdu na/ oṃ ma hā kā lā du beṃ ni dza go na ru tra rak+ṣa re ma ti ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab/ brtan phyir chu dbang bskur ba ni/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab la/ hūm̐ */ bum pa rang bzhin dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// bum bcud lha chen 'khor bcas ngo bo nyid// blug gtor dbang gis sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// rdo rje rnam gsum brtan phyir deng 'dir sbyin// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag

/rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan par byas chu lhag ma yar gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam/ de nas lus lhar bsgyur ba lha rgyud kyi dbang ni/ gtso bo'i sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ rab 'jigs lha chen srin po'i gzugs| |tsan+dan beng chen thogs pa po// srid gsum mnga' mdzad drag po che// lha chen sku yi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā du beṃ ni dza kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes mgor bzhag / srin mo'i skus/ hūm̐ */ yum gcig srin mo ma rungs pa// nam mkha'i khams kyi dbang mo che// srin mo 'bar ba mi sdug gzugs// mkha' dbyings yum gyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ trag rak+ṣa rak+mau rāk+ṣa sī de wī hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ zor can gyis/ hūm̐ */ lha mo mi bzad zor ba can// gcer mo phyag rgya lnga dang ldan// g.yon bskum gar gyis sa gsum g.yo// las mdzad ma mo'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā lā dun+tiṃ rak+mo kha la ma hī dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ bal mo'i skus/ hūm̐ */ bal mo mi sdug 'jigs gzugs can// nam mkha'i gos can skra grol ma// mchog gi phur pas dgra bgegs sgrol// bal mo nag mo'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ mu na rak+sha dza mu na kha bya rbad hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ stobs chen gyis/ hūm̐ */ las mdzad nag po stobs chen po// dar nag ber gyon bdud rta zhon// ral gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod// bdud mgon nag po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya to ya phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes 'khor bzhi po'i sku lag tu gtad la/ de nas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /lus lhar bsgyur ba ma hā kā lā tsan+dan gyi beng 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku bskyed pa'i rim pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// ngag sngags su bsgyur ba gsung gi dbang ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas mdun gyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal nas rang rang gi sngags phreng byung ba slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas par zhugs shing snying ga'i sa bon la thim par bsam la/

gtso bo'i rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po/ nye snying*/ 'khor bzhi'i sngags dang*/ shā sa na'i sngags rnams rjes zlos tshar gsum byas rjes bgrang phreng gtad la/ hūm̐ */ lha chen 'khor bcas thams cad ni// gnad nas bskul ba sngags kyi sgra// gzhom med rlung sngags grangs med pa// bzla phyir drag po'i phreng ba sbyin// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā wāka man+t+ra a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes sbyin/ des ngag gi nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs sbyangs/ lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi snying po gzhom du med pa na da'i sgra dbyangs bzla ba la dbang bar byas so// yid ting nge 'dzin du bsgyur ba thugs kyi dbang ni/ tsan+dan gyi beng chen gtad la/ hūm̐/ lha chen phyag mtshan rab rngam pa// beng chen 'bar ba che brjid 'di// dgra bgegs dpung dang mu stegs kyi// klad pa 'gems phyir bdag gis sbyin// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya tsan+dan daṇ+ḍa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ lcags par gtad la/ hūm̐ */ gdug pa 'dul phyir gnam lcags kyi// par bu nag po khri mun 'bar// log 'dren 'dzud pa'i phyag sbal te// las kyi rgyal po khyod la gtad// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā mu dra bha dza naṃ hūm̐ zhes gtad/ de nas yid kyi nyes ltung las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas lha chen po'i thugs ting nge 'dzin spros bral zhi ba chen po bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so// yon tan lhun gyis 'grub pa dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sman sbyin la/ hūm̐/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar ra sa yān// rmad byung dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gzhi// lha rnams thugs dam bskang ba dang*// dgra bgegs bsgral zhing rnal 'byor pas// dngos grub thob phyir khyod la sbyin// oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ rak+ta sbyin la/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs bsgral ba srog rtsa'i khrag /nā si pad+ma rak+ta dang*// 'ben gyi baṃ gyi snying khrag bcas| |rak+ta gsang ba'i dam rdzas sbyin// oṃ ma hā rak+ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ

gtor ma sbyin la/ hūm̐ */ dam rdzas kun 'dus mchog gyur pa// dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar brjid// zhi rgyas dbang drag las rab 'byams// sgrub byed dam pa khyod la sbyin/ */oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes sman raka gtor ma khar sbyin/ des ni lha thams cad thugs dam bskang ba dang*/ dgra bgegs log 'dren tshar gcod pa dang*/ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor pa dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa'i phyir yon tan kun 'byung dam rdzas khyad par can gyi dbang bskur ba yin no// phrin las drag po'i dbang ni/ ral gri gtad la/ hūm̐ */ phyi ni zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra// nang ni las rlung rnam pa bcu// gsang ba dug lngar bcas pa rnams// sgrol byed ye shes mtshon cha sbyin| |oṃ ma hā kā lā karma u gra khaḍ+ga bhu dza dat+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lag g.yas su gtad/ des ni ye shes kyi mtshon cha rnon pos nyon mongs sgrol ba dang ye shes kyi rlung gis las rlung bcu rang gnas su sgrol ba dang*/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor bas bstan la 'tshe ba dang*/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang*/ rnal 'byor par dam pa'i chos sgrub tu mi ster ba'i dgra rnams bsgral ba la dbang bar byas pa yin no// rjes su bka' gtad rab 'byams su bya ba ni/ gtor ma la gtso 'khor lnga gsal btab/ me sgron bltams pa thogs la/ hoḥ dpal bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ dgra bcom pa 'char ka/ rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can/ lo tsā ba dge ba'i go cha/ gsal ba'i tshul khrims/ gsal ba'i blo gros/ shes rab rin chen/ khams ston chos rje/ kre bo mgon po yon tan grags pa/ cung gzhon rgyal ba/ rgyal ba grags pa/ bla chen grags rgyal/ shes rab blo gros/ byang sems gzhon dpal/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chos sgo ba theg chen/ grags gzhon| bkra shis rin chen/ chos lung pa grags bzang*/ ye shes 'od zer/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ grags pa rin chen/ dpal 'byor grags pa/

chos dbang grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen/ rin chen dpal 'byor grags pa/ phun tshogs rnam grags/ karma ngag dbang la sogs pa ring brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ thub pa'i dbang po/ lha chen tsan+dan gyi beng 'dzin/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa ste/ don dam byin rlabs zhal mthong nye brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po legs ldan nag po/ lha chen dpal 'bar/ beng chen mgon po/ bdud kyi dmag dpon/ bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i tshogs dang bcas rnams sring mo nam mkha'i khams kyi dbang mo dbyings phyug ma zhes pa nas/ bsam pa tsam gyis thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod cig sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pa'i bar phrin las gzhung gi las kyi gnyer gtad pa'i skabs ltar tshar gcig brjod/ slar shā sa na sbyar spos rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma slob ma'i mgor bzhag go// de ltar gtso 'khor thams cad kyi bka' gtad rab 'byams su bgyis pas chos skyong 'khor bcas dngos su lag tu gtad pa ltar 'byung ba'i man ngag zab mo gnad che ba yin no// de nas las bdag pho mo'i bka' gtad mi byed na tshogs la longs spyod lhag ma btang*/ dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod kyis byin chags par bya'o// las bdag pho mo'i bka' gtad byed na gtor ma zur gsum thog mde'u lta bu gnyis byas la sha khrag gis brgyan pa snod gcig tu bshams/ de nyid las bdag pho mo bskyed/ srog sngags ci 'grub bzlas shing gtor ma phul/ slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ hoḥ slob dpon rdo rje khro bo'i gtso// bdag la brtse bar dgongs nas kyang*// las kyi bdag po pho mo yi| |bka' gtad srog dbang bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

slob ma skad cig gis mgon por gsal ba'i mdun du tri dmar nag gnyis yongs su gyur pa las bdag gshin rje dmar po yab yum khrag gi mdog ltar dmar zhing rngam pa/ bse yi ral pa las khrag gi char 'bebs pa/ nyi zla'i spyan bsgrad pa/ sen mo rno dbal lcags kyu'i rtse mo las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ srin po pho mo'i g.yang gzhi sku la gsol ba/ phyag na srin po pho mo'i snying dang nang khrol thogs nas snying khrag zhal du rngub pa/ 'khor las kyi gshin rje bshan pa stong gis bskor bar gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ las bdag gshin rje dmar po yab yum skad cig gis mdun du bkug la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ trag rak+sha snying kha la rak+sha ya dun+tiṃ rbad dun baṃ baṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ las bdag pho mo'i gzugs slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan mgon po beng chen gyi// las bdag gshin rje pho mo gnyis// sku yi gsang ba khyod la gtad// las bdag sgom dang ma 'bral zhig |trag rak+sha snying kha la rak+sha ya dun+tiṃ rbad dun baṃ baṃ dza dzaḥdhu sa dat+ta hoḥ zhes dang*/ srog sngags khrag gis bris pa gtad la/ hūm̐ */ beng 'dzin chen po las kyi bdag /'chi bdag pho mo'i srog snying bcas| |de ring khyod la bdag gis gtad// las bdag srog sngags mi 'bral zlos// srog sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slar gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐ */ nag po chen po'i las bdag pho mo ni// gshin rje dmar po shin tu mi bsrun pa// gdug rtsub ma rungs che bas 'chun par dka'// legs par sgrub tshe snying nye bran 'khor bas// rdo rje slob mas dam las ma 'da' bar// las bdag pho mo sgrub cing mchod pa dang*// dus rgyun gtor mas tshim par gyis shig bu// las bdag gnyis kyang dam las ma 'da' bar// sngags 'chang bdag gi bu la gtad pas na// lus grib ltar 'grogs bran dang g.yog tu gyis// gang bcol las rnams thogs med grub par gyis// gal te dam las 'ga' zhig 'gal ba na// rdo rje'i bka' chad gnam lcags lta bu yis// mgo snying bkas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung*// de bas skal ldan rdo rje'i bu mchog dang*// las bdag gshin rje dmar po dang bcas pa| |gnyis ka dam las ma 'da' dam srungs shig

/ces dang srog sngags lan gsum brjod/ 'dir dam bsre ba'i gnad ches zab cing gnyan pa zhig yod pa ni slob dpon dgyes pa'i zhal las zhu ba snying ltar gces pa yin no// las bdag pho mo'i bka' gtad 'di shin tu gnyan pas mang po la mi bya zhing dam tshig bsrung nges pa re re tsam la sbyin par gnad zab pa'o/ /smras pa/ beng 'dzin 'khor bcas dbang bskur dang*// las bdag pho mo'i bka' gtad bcas// chos skyong 'di nyid bsgrub pa na// med thabs med do mig ltar srungs// de ltar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral gyi dbang gi cho ga las bdag pho mo'i bka' gtad dang bcas pa byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di'ang*/ jo gnubs chen po'i dbon po sde pa nor bu tshe thar gyis nan gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ shing lug mgo nya'i dkar po'i rgyal ba gnyis par pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
